text:
Maya (CEO): quick follow-up from todays all-hands  thanks for the sharp Qs on partner GTM and pipeline hygiene. dropping clarifications and owners here.
Aria (GTM): partners wanted a clear KPI set. what metrics will leadership surface weekly?
Noor (RevOps): proposed weekly KPIs: partner-introduced opps, demo->POC conversion, avg days to first AE touch, and partner enablement completion rate. will mock a dashboard.
Liam (Sales): for demo->POC conversion, can we require reps to tag demos as "partner-demo" so we can filter?
Noor (RevOps): yes  adding a "partner_demo" checkbox in CRM. retro-tagging script will run this afternoon.
Zoe (Marketing): partners asked for one-click collateral (deck + one-pager) and a short video. will produce co-branded assets and a share link.
Ana (Legal): legal note  we need a short permissive line for partners to use in outbound that doesn't imply commitments. i'll drop a vetted sentence by EOD.
Maya (CEO): good. demo environment question: engineering, can we provide a partner preview mode with telemetry but no prod data?
DevBot: partner-preview flag created at 1876004400. staging keys will auto-rotate daily.
Aria (GTM): coordination ask: when partners submit leads, do they go to partner ops or the AE first?
Maya (CEO): partner ops validates -> AE assigned within 24h -> strategic partners set co-demo auto-invite. we'll document in playbook.
Liam (Sales): tiny ops ask: calendar invite template + 5-line script for reps would save time.
Zoe (Marketing): creating templates now, will post in #sales-ops by tomorrow.
Noor (RevOps): action items I own: 1) CRM "partner_demo" field + validation 2) dashboard mock 3) retro-tagging run. ETA Fri.
Ana (Legal): action: one-line partner-safe outbound sentence and co-sell eligibility phrasing. ETA EOD.
Aria (GTM): action: partner playbook draft with routing rules, demo script, and asset links. will share a beta Monday.
Maya (CEO): final ask  please keep updates concise here. plan: pilot the flow with 3 partners + 4 reps next Wed. signups in the poll. :thumbsup:
Liam (Sales): ack, will volunteer east-coast reps.
DevBot: partner-playbook draft created at 1876004640 and linked in #product-docs.
